verdict.rationale: Neon ships an official, documented CLI (neon-docs-11, neon-probe-5) that a runtime probe ran keylessly from npm as `neon` v4.14.1 (neon-probe-rt-1). It has clear AI-native subcommands: `init`/`mcp`/`plugins`/`skills` set up coding agents, with `-y --agent` for unattended runs; `ask` supports JSON output; `claim` handles keyless provisioning; and `api-keys` manages credentials. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agent workflows driven by the CLI, beyond the version probe.
